title: Gateway Outbox Event Envelope Validator
description: Test-only wrapper combining gateway-event-schema-v1.json's EventEnvelope definition (envelope-level required fields, event_id pattern, schema_version const) with its root oneOf (payload-per-type). The upstream schema's root only enforces the payload branch, so this composition is needed to validate a complete wire envelope. The upstream document is registered by its $id via AddResource in wire_schema_test.go.
